reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Butler chat priority, Work board, agent access, and check-in history controls
reason: Eleven selected Python cases cover chat and Work model/API controls, revision checks, idempotent check-ins, all-history paging, bounded Unicode reads, capability discovery, project isolation, and product-knowledge synchronization. Seventeen frontend cases cover Work page setting/readback states, Work destination wording, and mobile chat drawer restoration; the CI frontend command gives large Work fixtures 15 seconds per case. Eight real-Core browser profiles exercise Butler's chat and Work actions, saved Work setting, check-in history, and UI state after refresh at desktop, compact, Android-sized Chromium, and iPhone-sized WebKit viewports.
exclusions: No native source changed, so no native tests are selected. Unrelated Python, frontend, and Playwright journeys are excluded. The browser profiles emulate mobile devices; physical Safari was not available.
